Connected Drive evidence proves later Archive Doctor integration through GameSync 0.25.12 and the recovered V2-289 checkpoint/parity system, including exact support-tool hashes, multipart/checkpoint identity, oracle-integrity proof, tamper detection, atomic readiness and readback-before-ready behavior.
